title: A plan gate with counts and exceptions
heading: A Plan Is Data: Stop the Ones That Destroy History
cases: each change is counted by its verb, and the delete of a protected type is blocked
a replacement counts once, and is blocked whether it destroys first or creates first
a protected resource is recognised by its type, also inside a module
an address on the allowed list may be deleted; others of its type may not
deleting an unprotected type passes, and a data source read is counted as a read
